long long count_digits(long long n) {
    int count = 0;
    while (n != 0) {
        n /= 10;
        count++;
    }
    return count;
}

long long get_max_repeating_ones(long long n) {
    int digits = count_digits(n);
    long long result = 0, power_of_ten = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < digits; i++) {
        result += power_of_ten;
        power_of_ten *= 10;
    }
    if (result <= n) return result;
    return ((result - 1) / 10);
}

long long compute(long long n) {
    if (n <= 6) return n;
    if (n <= 11) return 13 - n;
    long long base = get_max_repeating_ones(n);
    long long next_num = base * 10 + 1;
    if (n % base == 0) {
        if (n <= (next_num / 2 + base))
            return count_digits(base) * n / base;
        return count_digits(next_num) + compute(next_num - n);
    } else {
        long long m = (n / base) * base;
        long long res = compute(m) + compute(n - m);
        if (n > next_num / 2)
            res = min(compute(m) + compute(n - m), count_digits(next_num) + compute(next_num - n));
        return res;
    }
}

int main() {
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << compute(n) << endl;
    return 0;
